opening: It came on gradually, more than 5 years ago.
Everything got worse over the first 3 years, but it has stayed the same since then.
The first thing I noticed was that I couldn't keep a grip on things I was holding.
Gradually it became hard to do fine things like buttoning my clothes, writing, combing my hair and using cutlery.
Over the same years the muscles of my right hand have been getting thinner.

opening.text: My right arm is weak. It came on gradually, more than 5 years ago. The first thing I noticed was that I couldn't keep a grip on things I was holding. Gradually it became hard to do fine things like buttoning my clothes, writing, combing my hair and using cutlery. Over the same years the muscles of my right hand have been getting thinner. Everything got worse over the first 3 years, but it has stayed the same since then.
